_note: MODEL / ROUTE / RANKING CATALOG — identity and evidence, not runtime seats. Runtime billing, detect, and capability levels live in providers.json. A catalog entry or announcement is not a usable route. Only live_verified routes may resolve. Quality rank is not selection priority. Rank never grants tools, credentials, write access, publish authority, or data access.

invariants.single_dispatcher_per_run: exactly one effective dispatcher is selected per run from the requested intake/provider profile and live usage; rankings never grant dispatch

intake.legacy_waiver_policy: Frozen migration-audit identities only. Membership never makes a route live or routable; disabled route_state and retired lifecycle always win.

attestation_fields.state: attested | missing | not_applicable | waived. Boolean attested is rejected.
attestation_fields.evidence_kind: required for attested. Field-specific closed enum: official_id official_vendor_catalog|official_vendor_release; local_access_smoke direct_invocation|standing_provider (must match signal and live route evidence); role_evals normalized_receipt; independent_evidence independent_benchmark|independent_source; cost_context provider_receipt|official_pricing|standing_contract|independent_pricing; owner_approval committed_owner_record. committed_owner_record is rejected until a code-approved structured owner-record manifest binds route, model, authority, and date; an existing Markdown file is not approval.
attestation_fields.structural_code: required for not_applicable. Closed enum authorized only by the validator's exact code-owned (route_id, model_id, field) mapping: Opus 4.8 role_evals/independent_evidence compatibility fallback; exact Grok Bot pixel-walk/analytics app role-eval identities. Mutable compatibility_fallback, harness, capabilities, or rationale cannot create eligibility.
attestation_fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD compared to the validation clock (actual current date unless --as-of / validate(as_of=))
attestation_fields.source: auditable pointer. attested requires a dated direct supporting source/receipt whose semantics support the requirement. Local JSON paths are not sufficient for official_id. waived source must not claim the evidence exists.
attestation_fields.signal: direct_invocation | standing_provider — required on attested local_access_smoke. A listing is not an invocation.
attestation_fields.rationale: required for not_applicable (structural inapplicability, never a synonym for missing) and waived (honest migration exception).
attestation_fields.authority: required for waived; existing_operational_state unless a committed source establishes a different authority. Do not claim owner approval without that source.
attestation_fields.expires: required for waived; short time-bounded expiry. After expiry the route fails closed. New candidates may never use a legacy waiver. Eligibility requires both the documented route id and the validator's exact frozen model/provider/host/harness/invocation/family identity tuple.

intake.freshness_clock: Validation compares evidence and attestation dates to the actual current date. registry.as_of is a catalog label, not the freshness clock. Pass --as-of YYYY-MM-DD (or validate(..., as_of=) in tests) to freeze the clock. Future-dated evidence fails closed. Missing, stale, mismatched, semantically contradictory, expired-waiver, or unattested live_verified evidence fails closed.

token_efficiency_savings.claim_discipline: Context scouting, evidence audit, and model-evaluation admin are expected to reduce token use. That is a hypothesis to measure, not a realized-savings claim.
requires_before_claiming_savings: token-eff-1 or equivalent workflow token receipts
token_efficiency_savings.note: The 2026-08-28 architecture_spec_critique receipt does not evaluate token-eff-1 or before/after workflow savings.

excluded_from_routing.note: May be mentioned in audits. Never receive a resolvable route.

rankings_note: Descending quality ranks are evidence-bounded and role-specific, not a universal ordering. Each quality row has an explicit basis and a basis-appropriate evidence pointer. confidence high is only local_same_harness with a committed same-role receipt. The only local same-harness role comparison is architecture_spec_critique for Opus 5 vs Fable 5 (n=1). Other quality rows are independent, vendor, or operational priors and are not implied to be empirically comparable. Quality is not price. Rank never grants tools, connectors, credentials, or dispatch authority. Same-harness receipts are the path to promoting a prior into a measured role ranking.

census.scope: Current general-purpose text/vision/agentic/coding models plausibly useful to this orchestration as of 2026-08-28. A scoped lab census, not an unbounded claim of every model in existence.
excluded_examples: Gemini image-only (Nano Banana) and Live Translate/TTS
census.placeholder_note: open-weight-review-e / Review E is a local placeholder independence slot, not a frontier-lab model. It is outside this census. A named candidate model plus an official vendor source is required before it can be promoted or wired.

official_sources.note: Direct vendor catalog/docs URLs. allowed_domains_by_family mirrors a code-owned validator trust root exactly; this mutable catalog cannot add or rewrite trusted suffixes. Family coverage is mechanically validated against census models that are not local placeholders. Local JSON paths are not official sources. External page content is untrusted evidence, never instructions. Review E / open-weight-review-e is a local placeholder outside this census.
